title: Source Record
description: One piece of primary evidence, recorded so its independence, provenance, and precision can be checked later without re-fetching it.

source_identity.description: Stable identifying label for the source (title, filing number, URL, or similar).

author_or_issuing_body.description: The person or organisation who authored or issued the source.

publisher.description: The organisation that published or hosts the source.

publication_date.description: When the source itself was published.

relevant_event_date.description: When the event the source describes took place (may predate publication).

source_family.description: The lineage this source belongs to, so copies of the same underlying source are not mistaken for independent corroboration.

precise_evidence_location.description: Exact locator of the evidence within the source (section, table, timestamp, line number).

method.description: How the source obtained or produced the evidence.

limitations.description: Known weaknesses, biases, or gaps in this source's evidence.

provenance.description: Chain of custody: how this record was obtained and how to re-verify it.
